WP1-R1.title: fix WP1 review findings
acceptance: #1 These findings come from a code read only. The reviewer could not run tests or mypy, so confirm each root cause by running the failing test before fixing it.

#2 src/mem_mcp/mindmap/workflow_errors.py:27,35 defines its own `WorkItemError`, and `ReasonRequiredError` subclasses it. Since work_items.py now imports that class, it no longer subclasses `work_items.WorkItemError`. mcp/tools/_work_item_common.py:61 then re-raises it instead of mapping it. This likely causes the 3 e2e reason-required failures in tests/integration/test_mindmap_work_items_e2e.py. Make `work_items.WorkItemError` and `workflow_errors.WorkItemError` the same class: define it in workflow_errors.py, and have work_items.py import and re-export it. Don't create a cycle. Confirm the three e2e tests pass.

#3 src/mem_mcp/mindmap/workflow_moves.py:80-88: the fallback query uses `$1` and `$3` but passes only two args, so asyncpg raises a parameter-count error. That is why test_propose_move_bad_transition_raises fails. Fix the placeholder numbering. Keep the test's real fixture, and keep its assertion on `TransitionNotFoundError`.

#4 work_items.py:621,666,793: `move_work_item`, `set_work_item_status` and `set_work_item_kind` now return `WorkItem | WorkflowSignoffRequest`. This produces the mypy union-attr errors in mcp/tools/mindmap_work_set_status.py and mindmap_work_set_kind.py. Keep `set_work_item_kind` returning `WorkItem` only. In the status tool, narrow with `isinstance(result, WorkflowSignoffRequest)` and return a pending-signoff payload. Do not add `type: ignore`.

#5 tests/unit/mindmap/test_workflow_errors.py:57-65 scans the global `sys.modules` for `workflow_*` modules, so it depends on test order and proves nothing about cycles. Rewrite it to run `python -I -c 'import mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow_errors'` in a subprocess. Assert that the work_items and workflow_moves/crud modules are not imported as a side effect.

#6 work_items.py:691-694: `set_work_item_status` wraps everything in `except Exception` and re-raises `MoveBlockedError`. That hides permission, DB and reason errors. Catch only the specific workflow errors, and let `WorkItemError` subclasses propagate unchanged. In workflow_moves.py, `propose_move` and `sign_workflow_move` skip `_check_permission`, `status_changed_at` and `_record_change`. `sign_workflow_move` also never checks `signoff_roles` or that the signer is a team member, and `cancel_workflow_move` returns silently when the request is missing. Add the permission and role checks, and raise a not-found error. Add tests for these paths.

Add a pending-signoffs-for-me query to WP1, plus an MCP tool and a web endpoint, so the board and agents show the same list.; allowed_moves and blocked_reason are only read from the move response, so the board can't show them before a move is tried.
